==Description==
'''Highlands''' was a [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]-exclusive [[Maps|map]] during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] that took place high in the sky.

==Design & Path==
'''Highlands''' took place above the clouds on stone mountains, with some floating islands also being seen. Various trees and rocks were dotted around the map. In terms of man-made structures, there were very few objects, with collapsing rubble and podiums being the only evidence of civilization.

The brown pebble path began and ended at two caves. It took two figure-of-eights (crossing over itself once). It crossed several gaps between mountains on tall stone bridges.

==Strategy==
*Cliff space is limited on this map. Stacking towers on the mounds around the map is important.
*Due to the fact that the path crosses over itself on the first cliff, most of your firepower should be placed here.
*As the path takes several figure-of-eights, the [[Military Base]] and [[Mecha Base]] units can be quite useful on this map.
*Due to the circular nature of this map, the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]] can perform admirably here.
**Towers can be placed inside of the round path to allow maximum coverage of map length.
